purpose: Teach: 血糖/プラズマ/精子/形容詞/同胞/軍国/乳幼児/生誕

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の血糖値検診を補助しろ
lines.en: I want the company to subsidize employee blood glucose screening.
lines.style: Measured authority. Direct, no preamble. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to. Slight pause between clauses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プラズマ技術への投資を検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll look into investing in plasma technology.
lines.style: Careful, slightly mechanical. He's writing mentally as he speaks. Professional agreement without genuine engagement — he's bought time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不妊治療の社員支援を強化しろ、つまり精子保存等の費用も
lines.en: Strengthen our fertility treatment support for employees — include sperm preservation costs and related expenses.
lines.style: Clipped, deliberate phrasing. Each policy point distinct. The tone of someone reading a list they've prepared, but with underlying conviction. Slight emphasis on scope.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内文書の形容詞表現を統一します
lines.en: Yes. I'll standardize the adjective usage across internal documents.
lines.style: Flat acknowledgment. Automatic response without processing depth. He's nodding along, not truly following. Faint exhaustion underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、在外同胞社員のサポート体制を整えろ
lines.en: Set up proper support systems for overseas Korean employees.
lines.style: Same measured authority as before. Non-negotiable. Simple sentence structure. The weight of institutional responsibility in his voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。軍国主義的な企業文化は避けます
lines.en: Understood. We'll avoid any militaristic overtones in company culture.
lines.style: Mechanical repetition. He's clearly no longer tracking the actual requests — just pattern-matching and agreeing. Slight hollow quality to his affirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の乳幼児育児支援を厚くしろ
lines.en: Expand and strengthen parental leave and childcare support for our staff.
lines.style: Firm conclusion. Slightly slower pace — this one he clearly cares about. The most human inflection in the series. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の生誕記念イベントを企画します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize a memorial event for the founder's birthday.
lines.style: Final checkbox response. Tired but polished. He's sealed into pattern by now — no internal disagreement, no real thought. The conversation is ending.
